# Contributing to GMPH2007 Projects

Thank you for your interest in contributing!

## How to Contribute
1. Fork the repository
2. Create a descriptive feature branch (git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature)
3. Commit your changes (git commit -m 'feat: add amazing feature')
4. Push to your branch (git push origin feature/amazing-feature)
5. Open a Pull Request

## Pull Request Guidelines
- Ensure your code follows clean architecture and structured formatting.
- Include unit tests and verified signatures where applicable.
